turns.speaker: Steve
turns.text:
Hello there! It's great to see you taking an active role in promoting student well-being. While I don't have direct authority over campus facilities, I'd be more than happy to help you navigate the process.

First, it's important to gather support from fellow students and faculty members who share your concern. You could start by organizing a meeting or petition to demonstrate the demand for this service.

Next, approach your Student Government Association (SGA) or a similar student body organization. They often have the power to advocate for student needs and can collaborate with the university administration to implement changes.

As for examples, some universities have vending machines or kiosks that provide menstrual products for free or at reduced costs. Others have designated rooms equipped with menstrual products, providing a private and accessible space for students.

I encourage you to research these ideas and tailor your proposal to suit our campus community's needs and resources. Best of luck with your initiative!
